question: Silver Futures closing price on August 10, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "$66.42 or above": Wins if the official daily settlement (closing) price of the CME COMEX Front-Month Silver Futures contract (ticker: SI) on August 10, 2026, as reported by CME Group, is $66.42 per troy ounce or higher.
- "Between $63.56 and $66.42": Wins if the official daily settlement (closing) price of the CME COMEX Front-Month Silver Futures contract (ticker: SI) on August 10, 2026, as reported by CME Group, is at or above $63.56 and strictly below $66.42 per troy ounce.
- "Between $60.70 and $63.56": Wins if the official daily settlement (closing) price of the CME COMEX Front-Month Silver Futures contract (ticker: SI) on August 10, 2026, as reported by CME Group, is at or above $60.70 and strictly below $63.56 per troy ounce.
- "Below $60.70": Wins if the official daily settlement (closing) price of the CME COMEX Front-Month Silver Futures contract (ticker: SI) on August 10, 2026, as reported by CME Group, is strictly below $60.70 per troy ounce.

Clarification:
- "Closing price" refers to the official daily settlement price published by CME Group for the front-month Silver Futures contract (SI) at the end of the regular trading session on August 10, 2026.
